thread:
Paul (AE): FinEdge POC kickoff Friday. Needs SSE streaming into their proxy, function-calls for refund service, and Kafka-compatible structured output. Also need pricing and security answers. Who can own?
Sam (SE): I can own SDK + handshake. If proxy only supports SSE that's fine. Short example handshake:
POST /v1/connect
Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>
{"transport":"sse","features":["structured","tool_calls"]}
Sam (SE): Example structured tool event we emit:
{"meta":{"seq":1},"event":{"type":"tool_call","name":"create_refund","payload":{"order_id":"F-100","amount":9.99}},"status":"ok"}
Rina (DevRel): I'll add Rust/ws and Go/SSE snippets in a tiny repo and mapping docs to their Avro schema.
Alex (Sales Eng): Pricing: pilot credits available up to 25k tokens/day for 10 days. If they need steady capacity we propose a short reserved commit; I'll draft numbers after qps estimate.
Maria (Security): Send the FinEdge security questionnaire (link) and I'll fill initial answers: https://redwood.internal/security/questionnaire/FE123. Need KMS design and audit retention details from infra.
Paul (AE): Blockers: 1) questionnaire completed, 2) ephemeral creds demo, 3) confirm SSE path + sample mapping, 4) credit approval.
Sam (SE): I'll ship the sandbox + handshake script by EOD and include idempotency header example.
bridge-bot: Meeting created: FinEdge POC sync - Fri 09:30 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/finedge-poc
Paul (AE): Thanks team, will add agenda + attach questionnaire draft in the invite.
